text:
sam: Heads-up: EmberCompute asked for a tight perf/W + throughput bench next week for marketplace onboarding and a short co-announce. Scope: steady-state perf/W curves, p95/p99 throughput, and kernel tuning artifacts.

emily: Do they provide VPN + perfmon? How many rigs? Which model shapes?

leo-ember: We can open VPN + perfmon on nodes E1-E4 by Tue EOD. We'll expose PDU metering and perfmon. Model suggestion from us: ember-mini (512/2048).

narayan: Test matrix I propose: modes=fp16,int8,q4_0; kernels=stock,fused-attn,cublas-tuned. Powercaps: 300W/250W/200W for perf/W curve. Include KV-cache thrash and a sustained 1h steady-state run.

tess: Kernel knobs we'll try: ATTEN_FUSE=1, CUBLAS_TUNE=2 and memory allocator tweaks. Also we'll run with/without power lim for perf/W deltas.

emily: Telemetry minimum: run_id, ts, host_pdu_w(1s), socket_w, gpu_power_w, latency p50/p95/p99, ipc, l2_miss, kernel_dmesg snippet. We'll share aggregated CSVs and PNGs; raw traces require NDA addendum.

sam: Owners: Sam=bench ops, Narayan=kernel tuning, Tess=telemetry & analysis, Emily=PM & announce. Agreed?

leo-ember: Agreed. I'll get VPN up Tue and start the permission flow for the s3 bucket.

bench-bot: Scheduled run created: id=bench-1769900001 start=1769976000. Modes queued: fp16,int8,q4_0.

sam: Dry-run Wed, tuning Thu, final sweep Fri if VPN+perfmon are green. Need Ember to allow perfmon & debug symbols.

narayan: Please pin driver/stack in logs: nvidia-driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1, cuBLAS 12.1. If Ember can't match, we'll include compatibility rows. Add a regression hook that computes token logprob delta and sample diffs.

emily: I'll open the legal request for raw dumps. For partner comms: Ember wants an embargoed figure pack by Mon next week. Can we turn around numbers and sign-off by then?

tess: If tuning goes smoothly, yes. Allow +1 day buffer if regresses occur. We'll produce perf/W plots and per-route latency dashboards.

sam: Runner snippet for ops:
```bash
run-bench \
  --model ember-mini \
  --seq 2048 \
  --modes fp16,int8,q4_0 \
  --duration 3600 \
  --powercaps 300,250,200 \
  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-ember/bench-1769900001 \
  --rigs E1,E2,E3,E4
```

narayan: Also add a quality gate: compute avg token logprob delta vs baseline and fail if drop >0.5. We'll attach sample outputs for manual QA.

leo-ember: Noted. I'll confirm VPN + perfmon Tue AM. We can also provide a spare rig for longer iterations if needed.

legal-bot: Raw kernel traces are sensitive. NDA addendum recommended before sharing raw dumps; aggregated CSVs and plots can be shared without addendum.

emily: Action items: 1) Leo to enable VPN+perfmon Tue. 2) Bench ops prep harness + Console dashboard. 3) Kernel team to provide knobs and safe defaults. 4) Telemetry to create bucket and sharing policy. 5) PM to open NDA addendum with Legal and draft embargo playbook.

sam: I'll post the dry-run link after Wed. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
